liebermann.notes: A pontifical of c. 1140, belonging to Hereford in 1348, containing Iudicium Dei XI–XIV (ff. 209b–217), the Duel (added c. 1250, f. 243) and a Consecratio regis with the Sacramentum coronationis (f. 99). Most closely related to Tr and Vt 2.
